Every person and shoe stays at anatomically normal scale. No giant foreground shoes, miniature people, fused limbs, morphing people, portals or costume changes within a shot. Use clean editorial cuts where requested. Black Converse: classic high canvas collar, ivory rubber toe and sole, cream laces, round badge only on INNER ankle; plain outside. No invented lettering, titles, subtitles, floating logos, music, voice or sound. Sound is added in the edit. Restrained, emotionally believable acting.

Image 2 LEFT outfit only: Elena age 22, shoulder-length black curls, VIOLET short-sleeve calf-length dress and RED high-top Converse. Center wedding and right home outfits are NOT used. He gives a shy apologetic half-smile; she smiles warmly, takes his hand. 4–7s: wider two-shot, one simple salsa side-step and gentle half-turn together, natural hands, no acrobatics; violet dress sways. Other dancers only soft indistinct silhouettes far behind. 7–8s: cut to his normal-size black shoe completing a step on the wooden floor under brown trousers, no giant shoe and no miniature dancers. Tender first connection, not a stage performance.
